title: SourceArtifact payload
description: Output of the PRD §40.7 `fetch(descriptor, validators)` boundary. Feeds the corpus `source_artifact` table (PRD §35.3). `r2_key` is absent when licensing does not permit storing the bytes — its absence is meaningful, so it is optional rather than nullable.

r2_key.description: Object key in artifact storage. Absent when storage is not permitted by the licence assessment (PRD §35.3).

licence_snapshot_key.description: Natural key of the licence snapshot in force when the artifact was retrieved.
